Quick Bandages⬻ Feat 2
GeneralSkillHealingManipulate
Prerequisitestrained in Medicine
Frequencyonce per hour
RequirementsYou are holding healer's tools, or you are wearing them and have a hand free.

You dress a wound without troubling over the finer points. Attempt a DC 15 Medicine check.

Critical Success The target regains 2d8 Hit Points. Success The target regains 1d8 Hit Points. Critical Failure The target takes 1d4 damage.

SpecialYou can select this feat multiple times. Each time, choose a different proficiency rank at which the check succeeds.
